events.title: Demo 0.43 update: Milestone cards, better tutorial, performance fixes
events.summary: Hello everyone,Thank you for playing the Groundwork demo. Today we want to show you the MILESTONES feature and walk you through the changes since the last build.What are Milestones?In short: you don't have to do anything. They don't unlock anything. They're here so you can look at them. They are not achievements. There's no in-game currency, so we can't give you coins for them either. Sorry about all that.First of all: Milestones existed before, but they were just simple counters with weird tech

events.title: Demo 0.42 update: Meet DORIS, your new personal assistant
events.summary: Hello everyone,Thank you for playing the demo. Today we want to show you the original, unfiltered Groundwork experience, and our biggest public update, both for the game and the demo.Groundwork is a passion project made by two people. We started working on it in 2019, when it was just a tiny JS-based clicker game: no robots, no round planets, not even a rocket. events.title: Demo 0.34.4 update
events.summary: Hello everyone,We changed how the game loads its models. On some PCs the game froze before reaching the title screen. Now it starts normally.We also fixed saves that showed "Damaged or modified" and could not be continued. This happened on days when the planet had a special condition, such as long nights.
